gear.name: Gear
gear.description: A small brass gear. Smells like bubbles.
gear.pickup: A little brass gear! Somebody's machine must be missing this.

bubble_helmet.name: Bubble Helmet
bubble_helmet.description: A helmet made of one very large bubble. Fashionable, and very poppable.

glasses.name: Shelly's Glasses
glasses.description: Round pink spectacles. The lenses are thicker than a clam shell.
glasses.pickup: Pink glasses! These must belong to somebody who can't see very well.

shell_polish.name: Shell Polish
shell_polish.description: Shelly's special shell polish. It makes anything shiny enough to see your fins in.

ship_key.name: Ship Key
ship_key.description: A big iron key with a tiny anchor on it. It opens the treasure room.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: An old ship's lantern. A friendly glow-worm lives inside and does all the work.
lantern.pickup: A lantern! The glow-worm inside waves at me. Now I can see in dark places.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A sturdy iron bar. Good for prying things loose, gently.
crowbar.pickup: A crowbar. Handy for anything that's stuck.

pearl.name: Lucky Pearl
pearl.description: Captain Clam's lucky pearl. It glows a little when you tell it a story.
pearl.pickup: A glowing pearl! Captain Clam will be so happy.

recipe_page.name: Recipe Page
recipe_page.description: Grandma's kelp-cookie recipe. Step one: 'Love.' Step two: 'A little bit of seaweed.'
recipe_page.pickup: A soggy piece of paper... it's Grandma's cookie recipe!

cookie.name: Kelp Cookie
cookie.description: A warm kelp cookie from Grandma's never-ending batch. Share them with everyone!

dance_shoes.name: Dance Shoes
dance_shoes.description: Eight tiny sparkly dance shoes. Sidney says you only need two.

conch_shell.name: Great Conch Shell
conch_shell.description: The Great Conch Shell of Founder's Day! It hums a little when you hold it.
